$comment: Hard npm-tarball budgets against the measured pre-8.0.0 baseline. Packed and unpacked ceilings are set from current measurements with 5% headroom, then ratchet downward when real reductions land; an unmet fixed reduction target would leave the gate permanently red. The file ceiling is the prior 2,500-artifact limit plus two emitted files for each of 283 stable lr-* alias entries and 34 files of entrypoint headroom; explicit source/map rejection remains independent.
